notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Players were experiencing crashes by putting 2 "hand" cards on on top of each other. This interaction is never needed to beat any levels but once done could get players stuck in a loop of crashing due to the replay system which plays moves you submitted before exiting the game. Below are the updates that come from this issue.

[list]
[*] Fixed crash related to "hand" cards being placed on top of each other.
[*] Add option on level start which skips the replay feature.
[*] Allow players to interrupt the replay system by pressing directional buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Optional hint speed added to settings menu
[/list]

notes.title: Pokaban - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Saving progress[/h2]
There was an issue that prevented users from updating a level with a better score.
[list]
[*] The UI now will reflect the new star count and progress will be saved correctly.
[*] Completing a level will also show the accurate star count on the results screen.
[/list]
[h2]Hint system[/h2]
The hint system was not working as expected. The hint system will show a player the next best move to make. A hint will be given after a player has been inactive for a few seconds. The hints will show more frequently if you are struggling to complete a level.
[list]
[*] Added a default key-binding for hints.
[*] There has been a binding added to the settings menu.
[*] The hint text won't appear after completing a level, let the joker dance and enjoy it's victory!
[/list]

notes.title: Livestream with Pokaban developer
notes.content:
Join solo-developer for Pokaban mashumafi while he creates levels. He will be using the same editor that you can also use to create and share levels with friends and strangers on the steam workshop.

He will answer any questions about Pokaban or game development as a solo-developer.

notes.title: Pokaban Demo Now Available
notes.content: After months of work the Pokaban demo is now available on all platforms! It includes 20 levels to try out. I am looking for any feedback or bugs reports but also hoping everyone can have a fun and relaxing experience playing this poker puzzle game.

notes.title: Trailer, Discord and Wild!
notes.content:
[b]Steam Page Improved[/b]

Pokaban now has a trailer available that shows some gameplay! Take a look to better understand how to play. There are also more details in the descriptions sections of the store page.

[b]Discord[/b]

We would like for those interested to join the discord server at https://discord.gg/mfaH5Upf. Let's build a community passionate about poker or puzzles, all are welcome!

[b]Wild[/b]

There is a new feature in the works, wild.

Wild cards will allow for increased complexity in puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42176263/5a31af33db0c086a11994f03571f521f46586261.gif[/img]

Wild positions marked on the board will turn cards with matching suit or rank into wild cards as well. Be careful though, it will give the dealer an edge as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42176263/2c42439b9e7e9b56f10e0ebb12a3713fccdafea7.gif[/img]
